name: Nash Turbeville
headline: A piano. A voice. Your kind of night.
bio: I'm Nash Turbeville, a singing pianist bringing live vocals, familiar songs, and audience connection to venues, events, and cruise ships. My solo show pairs live vocals with versatile keyboard accompaniment for a full-band sound at a fraction of the cost of a full band. I also perform dueling pianos on cruise ships and put together duos, trios, quartets, and larger groups to suit your event. For weddings, my primary offering is cocktail-hour music, with ceremony piano and full reception entertainment also available.
teachingBio: Alongside performing, I consider private teaching opportunities on a personal, case-by-case basis. Get in touch to discuss your goals and availability.

equipment: For solo performances, I can bring my Yamaha DGX keyboard, using drum and bass patches for a full-band sound, along with my compact Bose L1 tower-array PA system. The discreet, versatile setup accommodates a wide range of venue sizes; we’ll tailor the sound to your space and event.
